description: Signed evidence that the user allowed a specific template pack to compose a specific character pack. Two-axis scope: temporal (how long) x target (whom it covers). Consent classes (profile_token vs likeness_binding) are separate switches. v1.1.0: two-axis scope, consent classes.

character_pack_id.description: The user's character pack that was bound. Never a raw face.

classes.description: Per-class grants. profile_token = name/city (text layer). likeness_binding = character-ref composition. Never one switch.

medium.description: How consent was captured: the Preview/Allow/Deny prompt or settings.

policy_version.description: Personalization policy version this receipt was issued under.

revoked_at.description: Set when the user revokes. A revoked receipt invalidates future serves; past anchored impressions stay factual.

scope.description: Two axes. temporal: how long the grant lasts. target: whom it covers (global = this sponsor everywhere, '*' ids).

signature.description: Device signature over the canonical JSON of this receipt EXCLUDING the signature object itself.

user_pseudonym.description: Pseudonymous device/user id. No raw identity, no biometrics, no raw face leaves the device.

window.description: Time box of the consent ('только сегодня'). Serves outside the window are invalid.

title: Consent Receipt v1.1 — signed personalization consent evidence (DRAFT)
